get_bear_picture.description: Get a picture of a bear at exactly the size you need, as a link ready to drop into an email, a web page or a record: the placeholder to reach for while the real image is still on its way. Ask for it in black and white, and turn on saving when a later step needs the file itself. No account or API key required.
get_bear_picture.display_str_template: Get a bear picture from Placebear.
get_bear_picture.name: get_bear_picture

parameters.description: How wide the picture should be, in pixels. 600 by default; anything up to 2000.
parameters.name: width

parameters.description: How tall the picture should be, in pixels. 400 by default; anything up to 2000. Clear it and you get a square picture, as wide and as tall as the width above.
parameters.name: height

parameters.description: Turn this on for a black-and-white picture instead of colour.
parameters.name: black_and_white

parameters.description: Off by default, because a link is all an email or a web page needs. Turn it on when a later step needs the file itself: attaching it to an email, uploading it to storage, or posting it into a chat.
parameters.display_name: Also save the picture as a file
parameters.name: save_as_file

black_and_white.description: Whether the picture was asked for in black and white.

content_type.description: The saved file's media type. Empty when the picture was not saved.

document_ref.description: The saved file's reference, for a step that attaches or uploads it. Empty when the picture was not saved.

documents.description: The saved picture, ready to attach to a later step. Empty unless 'Also save the picture as a file' was turned on.

content_type.description: The file's media type, e.g. image/jpeg.

url.description: A URL that serves the saved file.

file_url.description: A URL that serves the saved copy. Empty when the picture was not saved. This is not the picture's own address on placebear.com, which is 'url'.

height.description: How tall the picture is, in pixels.

image_tag.description: The same link as a ready-made HTML tag, sized and with alt text, for a step that writes an email body or a web page.

saved_as_file.description: Whether a copy of the picture was saved as a file.

size_bytes.description: The saved file's size in bytes. 0 when the picture was not saved.

url.description: The picture's address on placebear.com, ready to paste into an email, a web page or a record, or to use as an image source.

width.description: How wide the picture is, in pixels.

get_bear_pictures.description: Give this a list of sizes and get one bear picture for each, in the order they were given: the banner, the cards and the avatars of a mock-up, filled in one step. Nothing is fetched, so a long list costs no more than a short one. No account or API key required.
get_bear_pictures.display_name: Get bear pictures for a list of sizes
get_bear_pictures.name: get_bear_pictures

parameters.description: The sizes to get pictures for, one picture each, in the order given, written as width x height, for example 1200x400. A single number makes a square. Up to 100 at a time. Type them in, or wire a list in from an earlier step.
parameters.name: sizes

parameters.description: Turn this on for a black-and-white picture instead of colour.
parameters.name: black_and_white

black_and_white.description: Whether the picture was asked for in black and white.

pictures.description: One entry per size, in the order they were given.

height.description: How tall the picture is, in pixels.

image_tag.description: The same link as a ready-made HTML tag, sized and with alt text, for a step that writes an email body or a web page.

url.description: The picture's address on placebear.com, ready to paste into an email, a web page or a record, or to use as an image source.

width.description: How wide the picture is, in pixels.

urls.description: Just the links, in the same order, for a step that wants the addresses on their own.

description: Pictures of bears to stand in for the images you do not have yet. Ask Placebear for a width and a height and it hands back a bear at exactly that size: the placeholder for a mock-up, a demo email, a seeded test database or a design draft. Take one picture, or one for every slot in a layout in a single step, in colour or in black and white, as a link to embed or as a file to attach. No account or API key required.
